race.comment: BUTT HEADS (4) went forward last time and battled on gamely to finish just half a length from the winner in second over 1200m at this track. Best figures measure up and is sure to run well. ROYAL BOMBADIER (6) has been racing in great heart with two top-three finishes on end, the latest a second over 1210m at this circuit when he was prominent throughout. Looks well placed so expect another big run. POCKET EIGHTS (5) has put back-to-back victories together and shouldn't be taken lightly. Must be a chance along with last start winner EVERYWHERE (12) who also deserves a second look.
